current.title: Dhokebaaz Dulhan Ka Raaz
current.logline: 6 saal pehle, uski biwi aur sabse acche dost ne milkar use jail bhej diya tha. Aaj woh laut aaya hai — ek naye chehre, naye naam aur beshumaar taqat ke saath — sab kuch vaapas lene, aur unhe barbaad karne.

characters.name: Aryan Malhotra / Arjun Rathore
characters.secret: He is Aryan Malhotra, presumed dead, now a powerful magnate seeking revenge.
characters.want: To systematically destroy Rhea and Siddharth, reclaim his honor, and find justice.

characters.name: Rhea Malhotra Khanna
characters.secret: Conspired with Siddharth to frame Aryan for greed and ambition.
characters.want: To maintain her lavish lifestyle, power, and bury her past crimes.

characters.name: Siddharth Khanna
characters.secret: Aryan's ex-best friend and business partner who framed him and stole everything.
characters.want: To expand his empire, keep his dark secrets hidden, and enjoy his ill-gotten gains with Rhea.

arc: Part 1: Jail ki bars ke peeche, Aryan Malhotra ne sirf dhokha nahi, zindagi ki sabse badi saazish dekhi thi – uski apni biwi Rhea aur sabse acche dost Siddharth ki. 6 saal baad, Mumbai ke sabse bade hotel mein, Siddharth aur Rhea apni anniversary mana rahe the. Champagne ke glasses takra rahe the, music chal raha tha, jab darwaza khula. Ek lambi, taqatwar shakshiyat andar aayi, jiske face par ek chhota sa scar tha, aur aankhon mein aag. "Mr. Arjun Rathore," manager ne jhuk kar kaha. Rhea aur Siddharth dono ne uss naye businessman ki taraf dekha, anjaan ki wohi Aryan hai. Siddharth, Arjun ke paas aaya, apna haath aage badhaaya. "Welcome, Mr. Rathore. Suna hai aapki company is sheher ki sabse oonchi imaarat banana chahti hai?" Arjun ne muskurakar uska haath pakda, uski mutthi mein ice-cold mehsoos hua. "Agar main kahu... woh imaarat main aapko bana kar doonga... lekin uski neev... aapke apne haathon se rakhi jaani chahiye?"

Part 2: Siddharth ko Arjun ki baat thodi ajeeb lagi, lekin itne bade investor ko woh mana nahi kar sakta tha. Agle kuch hafte, Siddharth ki company mein ajeeb chizein hone lagi. Ek ke baad ek, uske bade deals cancel hone lage, bade clients bhaag gaye. Rhea ghar par chillati, "Yeh kya ho raha hai, Siddharth? Humare funds itne kam kaise ho gaye?" Siddharth pareshan tha. Ek din, ek bade press conference mein, Siddharth apni company ke naye project ka announcement karne wala tha, jab screen par ek galat presentation chal gayi – uski company ke saare financial scams ki details. Poora hall hans pada. Siddharth ka chehra laal ho gaya. Arjun, jo audience mein baitha tha, utha, aur Siddharth ke paas aaya, kandhe par haath rakha. "Mr. Khanna, business mein galti ki koi gunjaish nahi hoti. Kabhi-kabhi, insaan apne sabse khaas logon par hi bharosa karke galati kar jaata hai." Uski nazar ek pal Rhea par ruki. Siddharth ka sabse bada investor ne call kiya, "Main aapki company mein aur ek paisa nahi lagaunga, Mr. Khanna!" Siddharth kaanp gaya. "Lekin..." Call cut ho gaya. Arjun ne apna phone nikala. "Don't worry, Mr. Khanna. Main aapki company ko bachaunga. Lekin meri shart yeh hai... ki aaj se aapki company... mere naam par chalegi. Aur aap... sirf mera naam istemal karenge."

Part 3: Siddharth ne majboori mein Arjun ki shart maan li. Ab Arjun uski company ka CEO tha. Pehle din hi, Arjun ne Siddharth ke saare khaas logon ko nikaal diya, aur use bas ek chhota sa cabin de diya. Rhea gusse mein thi. "Tum kaise uske saamne jhuk sakte ho, Siddharth? Hamari izzat ka kya?" Arjun ne Rhea ko apne office bulaya, usse company ke naye plans discuss karne ke bahane. Usne Rhea ke liye coffee banayi, uski favorite – black coffee, jisme sirf do spoonful sugar. Rhea kaanp gayi. Aryan ko bhi waisi hi coffee pasand thi. "Mrs. Khanna," Arjun usse seedha dekhta hai, "suna hai aapko antiques ka shauk hai? Maine bhi apni kuch purani cheezein aaj bhi sambhaal kar rakhi hain. Kuch rishte bhi." Arjun ne apni desk par rakha ek chhota sa silver locket uthaya, jisme 'A' ka initial tha. Rhea ko yaad aaya, Aryan ne usse bhi aisa hi locket diya tha. Woh use haath mein lene lagi, Arjun ne jhat se vaapas rakh diya. Usi raat, Rhea ko ek emergency call aaya – uski ancestral property, jo usne gupt roop se mortgage ki thi, woh ab foreclosed hone wali thi. Usse ek badi amount chahiye thi, turant. Tabhi uska phone baja. Screen par Arjun Rathore ka naam flash hua. "Mrs. Khanna, aapka ek zaroori paper mere office mein reh gaya hai. Aaj raat aakar le jaaiyega. Main akela hi honga."

Part 4: Raat ke andhere mein, Rhea Arjun ke office pahunchi. Office ki roshni halki thi. Arjun uske saamne baitha tha, uske chehre par koi expression nahi tha. "Paper? Kaisa paper?" Rhea ne fafaya. Arjun ne apni drawer kholi aur ek purana music box nikala. "Yeh music box, Mrs. Khanna, kisi ne mujhe tohfe mein diya tha. Bilkul aapki tarah, us insaan ne bhi mujhe beech raaste chhod diya tha. Lekin yeh music box aaj bhi chal raha hai." Music box se Aryan aur Rhea ke wedding song ki dhun bajne lagi. Rhea ki saans ruk gayi. Woh kaanpti hui wahan se bhaagi. Agle din, Arjun ke office ki safai ho rahi thi. Rhea Siddharth se lad rahi thi, "Mujhe lagta hai woh humse kuch chhupa raha hai!" Tabhi cleaner ke haath se ek file giri, aur uske neeche ek secret compartment khul gaya. Rhea ki aankhein badi ho gayin. Andar ek half-burned photo thi – Aryan aur Rhea ki shadi ki. Aur uske neeche... ek purana, laminated ID card. Uspar naam likha tha... Aryan Malhotra. Rhea ne kaanpte haathon se woh ID uthaya. "Aryan," uske muh se nikal gaya. Usi pal, uska phone baja. Siddharth ka naam flash ho raha tha. "Rhea, tumhe Arjun Rathore ke baare mein kuch pata chala hai? Uski identity... asli nahi hai."

Part 5: Rhea aur Siddharth dono ki aankhon mein darr tha. Aryan zinda tha, aur wohi Arjun Rathore tha! Unhone turant Arjun ko expose karne ka plan banaya. Siddharth ne ek press conference bulayi, jahan woh Arjun ki asliyat batane wala tha. Lekin jaise hi usne mic pakda, screen par ek video chal gayi. Woh 6 saal purana CCTV footage tha – Siddharth aur Rhea ko ek doosre se baat karte hue dikhaya gaya, Aryan ko frame karne ki saazish karte hue! Poora hall shock mein tha. Siddharth ka muh khula reh gaya. Arjun Rathore utha, usne mic apne haath mein liya. "Siddharth Khanna, Rhea Malhotra... aapne socha tha ki ek gareeb aadmi ko jail bhej kar aap meri zindagi chheen lenge? Lekin aapne meri rooh ko zinda kar diya." Siddharth gusse mein Arjun ki taraf lapka, lekin security ne usse rok liya. Rhea wahin chair par behosh ho gayi. Arjun ne apna haath uthaya. "Ab tak toh sirf khel tha, Siddharth. Ab asliyat shuru hogi." Usne apni ungliyaan snap ki. Conference hall ke darwaze par police aa gayi. "Arrest them!"

Part 6: Siddharth aur Rhea ko police ne ghasit kar bahar nikala, media ke saamne unki badnaami ho rahi thi. Arjun Rathore bas khada dekh raha tha. Kuch din baad, Arjun unse jail mein milne gaya. Rhea rota hua zameen par baithi thi. "Aryan?" usne fafaya. "Maine kya kiya? Mujhe maaf kar do!" Arjun uske saamne jhuk gaya. "Maafi? Rhea, tumne sirf mujhe dhokha nahi diya. Tumne mera bharosa maara, meri pehchaan chhini. Woh dard... tumhare aansu nahi mita sakte." Siddharth gusse mein baitha tha. "Tu! Tune sab barbaad kar diya!" Arjun ne bas uski taraf dekha. "Main toh sirf hisaab chuka raha hoon, Siddharth. Woh hisaab, jo tumne mere naam par likha tha. Company, paisa, izzat... sab tumse chheen liya. Ab sirf tumhari aazaadi bachi hai." Kuch din baad, court mein judge ne unhe lamba prison sentence suna diya, aur unke saare assets seize kar liye gaye. Siddharth aur Rhea barbaad ho chuke the. Arjun Malhotra, ab Arjun Rathore, apni nayi company ki sabse oonchi building ki rooftop par khada tha. Hawa tez chal rahi thi. Uska phone baja. Usne ek pal ke liye phone ki taraf dekha, phir apni nazar shaher par daal di. "Khel khatam ho gaya," woh dheere se kehta hai, "lekin kahani abhi baaki hai." Usne phone uthaya.
current.soFar: 6 saal pehle, Aryan Malhotra ko uski biwi Rhea aur sabse acche dost Siddharth ne milkar jhoote ilzaamon mein jail bhej diya tha. Jail ki bars ke peeche, Aryan ne sirf dhokha nahi, apni zindagi ki sabse badi saazish dekhi thi. Usne har din apni badle ki aag ko sulgaaya, ek naya chehra, naya naam, aur beshumaar taqat ke saath lautne ka irada kiya. Aaj, 6 saal baad, Aryan Malhotra 'Arjun Rathore' ban kar wapas aa chuka hai. Siddharth aur Rhea apni 6th wedding anniversary mana rahe hain, anjaan ki unka sabse bada dushman unke saamne khada hai. Arjun ne unse ek aisi deal ka zikr kiya hai jo unki barbaadi ki neev banegi.
